body:
NexDuels

NexDuels is a PvP duel system for Minecraft servers that allows players to challenge each other in structured arena battles. It includes a GUI-based system for managing arenas, kits, player statistics, and leaderboards.

Players can send duel requests, accept or decline matches, and fight in fully configured arenas with countdowns, kit support, and automated match handling. After each match, statistics such as wins, losses, KDR, and rank are updated automatically.

The plugin also includes a ranking system based on match victories and a global leaderboard to track top players on the server.

NexDuels supports PlaceholderAPI for displaying player statistics in scoreboards, tab lists, and other UI elements.


![duels](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a27df5231394c98ef1a7ec9a1131078d87ed3eb5.png)

Features
GUI-based duel and arena management

Player vs Player duel system with requests

Arena creation and configuration system

Custom kit system with inventory saving

Countdown and match start protection

Automatic match handling and teleport system

Player statistics tracking (wins, losses, KDR, rank)

Rank progression system based on wins

Global leaderboard system

PlaceholderAPI support

Commands
/nexduels — Opens main menu

/duel <player> — Send duel request

/nexduels stats [player] — View player stats

/nexduels leaderboard — Open leaderboard

/nexduels arenas — List arenas

/duel <player> — Quick duel request


Admin Commands

/nexduels create <name> — Create arena

/nexduels delete <name> — Delete arena

/nexduels editor [arena] — Open arena editor

/nexlobby set — Set lobby location



Dependencies
PlaceholderAPI (Optional)


Supported Versions
Paper / Purpur / Spigot 1.21.x+


Developer

Hexages Games / Zcrosty
